meta.jurisdiction: England and Northern Ireland (rUK). Welsh rates of income tax currently match.
meta.note: Rates announced at Budget 2026 for 2027-28. Some need Finance Bill 2026-27 to become law.

sources.incomeTax.personalAllowance: Budget 2026 OOTLAR Annex A, Income Tax: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/budget-2026-overview-of-tax-legislation-and-rates-ootlar/annex-a-rates-and-allowances
